$comment: The bar's programme, in one editable list. `npm run programme:seed` loads it into the live
database; `npm test` validates it against the app's own event rules, so a bad row fails in CI
One object per event. Only `eventDate` and `title` are required; everything else falls back to
a sensible default (night_session / placeholder / 2 staff). The pair (eventDate, title) is the
identity: re-running the seed updates a row that is already there rather than duplicating it.
title         what the Programme Index shows in the TITLE column
artist        the ARTIST column; null when the title already names the act
genre         the GENRE column, e.g. 'Acid Jazz / Funk'
status        placeholder (date held, details TBA) | confirmed (act named, no link yet) |
ticketed | free_rsvp (both need ticketUrl) | private | cancelled
startTime     'HH:MM' 24-hour, or null while the time is TBA
endTime       'HH:MM', for sessions with a published finish
ticketUrl     the Humanitix link - only ever on a ticketed or free_rsvp event
description   the sentence under the title on events.html
staffRequired bar staff the night needs; Today warns when the roster is short
